title: 第三十七章 五贼盗天万化神符第三十六章 六欲天魔旗
lines: 第三十七章五贼盗天万化神符
静室内，乌金交加的火焰不断闪烁，涌动的光彩已然将王平淹没，重重堆叠下甚至已经看不清人形。
尤道姑见状，手中印决不断变化。
四周的篆文秘箓因此仿佛获得了生命，在熊熊光彩的照耀下不断扭曲，跃动，好似龙蛇在张牙舞爪。
而另一边，身处无穷光彩内的王平则是只剩下了一种感觉，那就是痛，烈火焚身的痛苦在他的体内深深扎根，甚至让他有些麻木了，身后的六欲浑天魔更是单膝跪地，焦黑的肌肤难以在蜕下。
【卸甲】也是有极限的。
毕竟这只是六欲浑天魔自带的神异，根本不是真正的法术，又如何能够扛住尤道姑精心准备的灵火。
‘我得忍住。’
尽管身处剧痛之中，王平的思考依旧清醒，如果此刻动用【气禁】，那他自信还可以坚持几个时辰。
但是——不能用。
‘我无法解释【气禁】是从哪学来的，就算用出来也不能绝地翻盘，只会打草惊蛇，没有任何意义。’
看来这一世到此为止了。
王平已经有点认命了，然而就在这时，阵法外的尤道姑却突然睁开美眸，随后皱着眉朝他看了过来：
“怨气呢？”
“好不容易踏上了修仙之路，却突然被我炼成法器，有了希望又化为绝望，沦落至此居然没有怨气？”
尤道姑有些不解。
不过更多的还是忧虑：“这可不行，少了怨气，这【六欲天魔旗】晋升上品的几率怕是都要下降的。”
想到这里，尤道姑手中的法决立刻变化，几乎同时，王平也察觉到了阵法的改变，周身的乌金光彩中，竟有一头头异形怪状，容貌奇诡的虚幻之物钻出，接着便一股脑地涌入了他的眉心深处。
王平当即闷哼一声，眼前浮现出重重幻境，也认出了这些虚幻之物：“是魔头.....不好，他要做什么？”
魔头，又称游魂，阴鬼。
顾名思义，乃是地阴浊气所生，无形无质，却又喜好生人，又入侵识海之能，吞吃修士的七情六欲。
寻常修士对其都十分忌惮。
只因此魔凶恶，偏偏无形无质，所以天敌极少，又专攻识海，可谓防不胜防，稍有不慎就会沾染上。
而一旦沾染上了，轻则性情大变，重则发狂而死。
就比如现在，随着大量魔头涌入识海，王平心中立刻不受控制地浮现出了昔日种种，过往无数画面。
比如他在北辽的困苦童年，少年时立志要超越所有人，成为王庭的一员，青年时在草原上骑着马肆意驰骋，中年得知了修仙的存在，于是求取仙道，要长生不老，再到得知没有灵根时的绝望.....
不对，这不是我啊。
看着眼前完全陌生的父母，子女，爱人，师长，王平猛然清醒了过来：‘这是......前身记忆的走马灯！’
‘是了，那毒妇想要我的怨气！’
所谓怨气，自然是来自前身那求仙而不得的含恨回忆，然而这是前身的问题，和他王平有什么关系？
切割！必须切割！
想到这里，王平立刻收拢心念，将前身的记忆顶在了前面，任由魔头在其中穿梭，勾动记忆中的怨恨，不一会儿，前身的记忆就渐渐变得残破，识海随之破碎，浓重的怨气也从中渐渐飘荡起。
“我好恨！”
“天地不公，为什么我无法修仙？我不甘心.....”
content_en:
Chapter 37: Five thieves steal the Talisman of Ten Thousand Transformations from Heaven
In the quiet room, the flames of black and gold kept flickering, and the surging brilliance had already engulfed Wang Ping, and even the human form could not be seen clearly under the heavy stacks.
Seeing this, Aunt You saw the seals in her hands changing constantly.
The surrounding seal script secrets seemed to have gained life, and they were constantly twisting and dancing under the blazing light, like dragons and snakes baring their teeth and claws.
On the other side, Wang Ping, who was surrounded by infinite brilliance, was left with only one feeling, and that was pain. The pain of burning his body was deeply rooted in his body, even making him a little numb. The Six Desire Demon behind him knelt down on one knee, and his charred skin was difficult to shed.
[Armor Removal] also has a limit.
After all, this is just the magical power of the Six Desires Hound Demon, not a real spell at all, so how can it withstand the spiritual fire carefully prepared by Taoist Aunt You.
'I have to hold it in. ’
Although he was in severe pain, Wang Ping was still thinking clearly. If he used [Air Absence] at this moment, he was confident that he could hold on for a few more hours.
But - it doesn't work.
‘I can’t explain where [Qi Bin] was learned from. Even if you use it, you won’t be able to make a comeback. It will only scare the enemy, which is meaningless. ’
It seems this life is over.
Wang Ping had already accepted his fate, but at this moment, Taoist Aunt You, who was outside the formation, suddenly opened her beautiful eyes, and then looked towards him with a frown:
"Where's the resentment?"
"I finally embarked on the path of cultivating immortality, but suddenly I made a magical weapon. My hope turned to despair. I have fallen to this point and don't have any resentment?"
Aunt You was a little puzzled.
But the more worrying thing is: "This is not possible. Without resentment, the chances of this [Six Desires Heavenly Demon Banner] being promoted to the top level will probably decrease."
Thinking of this, the spell in You Daogu's hand immediately changed. Almost at the same time, Wang Ping also noticed the change in the formation. From the black gold light around him, illusory objects with strange shapes and strange looks came out, and then poured into the depths of his eyebrows.
"Woo!"
Wang Ping immediately groaned, many illusions appeared in front of his eyes, and he recognized these illusory objects: "It's the devil... No, what is he going to do?"
Devil, also known as wandering ghost, ghost.
As the name suggests, it is born from the turbid air of the earth. It is invisible and has no quality, but it likes strangers, invades the sea of ​​consciousness, and devours the seven emotions and six desires of the monks.
Ordinary monks are very afraid of it.
Because the demon is vicious and invisible, it has very few natural enemies, and it specializes in the sea of ​​consciousness. It can be said that it is difficult to guard against, and you will be infected if you are not careful.
And once it is contaminated, the temperament may change drastically, or the person may go crazy and die.
Just like now, as a large number of demons poured into the sea of ​​​​consciousness, Wang Ping's mind immediately emerged uncontrollably from the past and countless scenes from the past.
For example, he had a difficult childhood in Bei Liao. When he was young, he determined to surpass everyone and become a member of the royal court. When he was young, he rode a horse on the grassland. In middle age, he learned about the existence of immortality, so he sought immortality and immortality. Then he felt despair when he learned that he had no spiritual roots...
"...Huh?"
No, this is not me.
Looking at the completely unfamiliar parents, children, lovers, and teachers in front of him, Wang Ping suddenly came to his senses: 'This is... a revolving door of memories from his previous life! ’
‘Yes, that poisonous woman wants my resentment! ’
The so-called resentment naturally comes from the resentful memories of the predecessor who sought immortality but failed. However, this is the problem of the predecessor. What does it have to do with him, Wang Ping?
Cut! Must be cut!
Thinking of this, Wang Ping immediately gathered his thoughts, held the memory of his predecessor in front, and allowed the devil to shuttle through it, stirring up the resentment in his memory. After a while, the memory of his predecessor gradually became fragmented, the sea of ​​​​consciousness was shattered, and a strong resentment gradually floated from it.
"I hate it so much!"
"The world is unfair, why can't I cultivate immortality? I'm not willing to..."
